result.summary: Introduces a new "mining" logging category (enabled with -debug=mining) and changes the CreateNewBlock() log message from LogInfo to LogDebug using this category.
result.problem: CreateNewBlock() unconditionally logs block weight, transaction count, fee, and sigop metrics every time a block template is assembled. Node operators running software that frequently builds templates (such as electrum servers) experience debug.log spam that cannot be filtered out without modifying source code.
evidence: Issue #36334: 'log: frequent `CreateNewBlock()` log lines on 32.x with electrum server'
PR description: 'The "CreateNewBlock(): block weight: ..." line was logged unconditionally and could not be turned off, filling the debug log when block templates are built frequently.'
result.changed_since_previous: Diff and functional test in test/functional/mining_basic.py added (previous description had no patch).
result.card: Introduces a new mining logging category (-debug=mining) and moves the CreateNewBlock() block template log message behind it. Previously, the line logged unconditionally on every template build, flooding debug.log for node operators running software like electrum servers that frequently request block templates. Issue #36334 reports log bloat with no existing mechanism to disable the output.

risk.why: Only adjusts the logging level and category of a single debug print.
